scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@fiap-x/auth-service --workspace=@fiap-x/frontend --workspace=@fiap-x/notification-service --workspace=@fiap-x/processor-service --workspace=@fiap-x/video-service
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=@fiap-x/config --workspace=@fiap-x/contracts --workspace=@fiap-x/observability --workspace=@fiap-x/test-utils && npm run build --workspace=@fiap-x/infrastructure
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --build --pretty false && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('coverage', { recursive: true, force: true });" && npm run clean --workspaces --if-present
